header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: strength?’ he asked. “For the believer it will be made as light as the time it takes to perform one Fard Salah,” Hazrat Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكِ نِ اْلاَشْجَعِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَتَانِي آتٍ مِنْ عِنْدِ رَبِّي فَخَيَّرَنِي بَيْنَ أَنْ يُدْخِلَ نِصْفَ أُمَّتِيَ الْجَنَّةَ وَبَيْنَ الشَّفَاعَةِ فَاخْتَرْتُ الشَّفَاعَةَ وَهِيَ لِمَنْ مَاتَ لَا يُشْرِكُ بِاللهِ شَيْئاً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي باب منه حديث تخييرالنبي ﷺ .... رقم:٢٤٤١
blocks.tamil_translation: “An angel came to me from Allah. He said that permission had been given from Allah for me to choose one of two things: having half of my Ummah enter Jannah, or granting me the right to intercede (for all). (So that all Muslims benefit, without a single one left out) I chose the right to intercede for them. Therefore, my intercession is for whoever dies without associating partners with Allah,” Hazrat Awf ibn Malik al-Ashja'i (RA) narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: شَفَاعَتِي لِأَهْلِ الْكَبَائِرِ مِنْ أُمَّتِي.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن صحيح غريب باب منه حديث شفاعتي....،رقم:٢٤٣٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “Among my Ummah, my intercession belongs only to those who committed major sins (not to the rest of the Ummah),” Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.
